exposure: retrospective; primary results inspected 2026-10-03; no prospective or raw-data replay claim

redshift.observable: reversal frequency contrast divided by measured 2gh/c^2
redshift.systematic_distribution: unspecified; bounded nuisance, not a Gaussian standard deviation

deflection.location: Fomalont et al. (2009), Table 5; Section 4 template convention
deflection.observable: differential angular-deflection amplitude relative to GR: (1+gamma)/2
deflection.template: published residual P = (gamma-1) D/2, not gamma D and not (gamma+1) D/2
deflection.covariance: same observations reused across rows; cross-row covariance and raw likelihood not supplied; never combine as independent

screened_not_scored.reason: Galileo clock reduction also consumes orbital and propagation models; a common spatial-response change cannot be scored by inserting alpha=0 without redoing or bounding that reduction. Use the static resonance measurement for this bounded paired test.
